subject: The one mistake that ruins 90% of predictions
preview_text: Most users skip this one step and lose out on the most accurate insights. Don't be one of them.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I see it every single day. A user downloads Predictify, gets excited, and then makes the one mistake that completely tanks their results. They think they're getting the full picture, but they're missing the single most important piece of data. It's like trying to predict a match without knowing who's injured.

The mistake? Relying ONLY on the final score prediction. That's just the headline. The real value—the thing that separates a guess from a knowing—is in the Confidence Score. Thousands of variables get crunched, but if you ignore that percentage, you're flying blind. You'll miss the value bets, the tight games, the upsets that the data screams about. It's the difference between feeling smart and actually being right.

Here's the fix, and it takes two seconds. Before you lock in any pick, tap on the match. Scroll past the predicted score. Look for the Confidence Score. That's your true north. 85%+? That's our AI screaming its confidence. Below 60%? That's a warning that anything can happen—the perfect spot for an underdog bet or to just enjoy the chaos. This score is why Premium users consistently spot what others miss.

Open the app right now. Pick any upcoming match and find the Confidence Score. See what you've been skipping. It changes everything. P.S. The users who check this score daily have a 73% higher win rate on value bets. Seriously. It's that powerful.
